My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
If the tracking shows delivered but you have not received the package, please follow these steps:
Check around the delivery location
Inspect doors, side entrances, garage, mailbox area, or building reception.
Ask neighbors or anyone in your household if they received the package.
Wait a short time and recheck tracking
Carriers sometimes mark packages as delivered before actual arrival. It may arrive later the same day or the next day.
Contact the carrier directly
Use the tracking link to request delivery details, such as the exact location where the package was left.
Review your order details in your account
If you are signed in, you can look up your order and tracking information.
